questions.question: When a young lion attacked Samson and the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, what did Samson do to it?

answers.text: Tore it apart with his bare hands
Drove it off with his staff
Chased it out of the vineyards

questions.question: At his wedding feast, Samson told a riddle about something sweet coming out of the strong. What was it really about?

answers.text: The honey in the lion's carcass
The grapes in the vineyards of Timnah
The food served at the feast

questions.question: At his wedding feast, Samson finally told his wife the answer to his riddle. What did she do with it?

answers.text: Explained the riddle to her people
Kept it secret until the feast ended
Told it to Samson's father and mother

questions.question: After Samson left the wedding feast angry and went to his father's house, what happened to his wife?

answers.text: She was given to one of the men at the feast
She went with Samson to his father's house
She was sent away to live in Ashkelon
